nodes.description: IERC20 token held by the TokenTimelock contract.
Address that receives the released tokens.
Timestamp after which tokens can be released.
Constructor validating releaseTime against block.timestamp and setting _token, _beneficiary and _releaseTime.
View function returning the held token.
View function returning the beneficiary address.
View function returning the release timestamp.
Public function that checks block.timestamp against _releaseTime and transfers the whole token balance to the beneficiary.
Block timestamp used as a time gate in the constructor and in release().
Low-level address(token).call(data) in SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn, which forwards execution to an arbitrary token contract before state is finalized.
External call _token.safeTransfer(_beneficiary, amount) inside release(), which performs a token transfer to an external callee.
Constructor parameter for the ERC20 token address.
Constructor parameter for the beneficiary address.
Constructor parameter for the release timestamp, compared with block.timestamp.
Local variable holding the token balance transferred in release().

edges.reason: Constructor parameter token is stored into the state variable _token.
Constructor parameter beneficiary is stored into the state variable _beneficiary.
Constructor parameter releaseTime is stored into the state variable _releaseTime.
Constructor writes the token address into _token.
Constructor writes the beneficiary address into _beneficiary.
Constructor writes the release timestamp into _releaseTime.
Constructor require(releaseTime > block.timestamp) depends on the block timestamp.
release() gates execution with require(block.timestamp >= _releaseTime), a timestamp dependency.
_token is read in release() to query the balance and perform the transfer.
_beneficiary is read in release() as the transfer destination.
release() invokes the external unsafe operation safeTransfer.
Local variable amount is passed to the safeTransfer call.
safeTransfer routes through callOptionalReturn, which makes the low-level call to the token contract.
The low-level call made via safeTransfer can re-enter release() before completion.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor input parameter token only feeds the assignment to _token and has no independent semantics.
Constructor input parameter beneficiary only feeds the assignment to _beneficiary and has no independent semantics.
Constructor input parameter releaseTime is consumed by the timestamp require and the _releaseTime assignment.
Local variable amount exists only to supply the value argument of the safeTransfer external call.
